title: Colors & Backgrounds 🌈
description: Set colours for text and backgrounds using keywords, hex, RGB, HSL, and control background images.

slides.title: The `color` Property 🎨
slides.content:
# Changing Text Colour

`color` sets the foreground colour of an element's text and also affects some decorations like underlines.

Accepted formats:
- **Keywords:** `red`, `blue`, `transparent`.
- **Hex:** `#FF0000` (red), `#000` (shorthand for #000000).
- **RGB/RGBA:** `rgb(255, 0, 0)`, `rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.5)` (alpha for transparency).
- **HSL/HSLA:** `hsl(0, 100%, 50%)` (hue, saturation, lightness).

```css
p {
  color: #2c3e50;
}
```

quizData.question: Which colour format allows you to set opacity directly?
quizData.explanation: `rgba()` and `hsla()` have an alpha channel for transparency.

slides.title: Background Properties 🖼️
slides.content:
# More Than Just `background-color`

The `background` shorthand covers many sub‑properties:
- `background-color` – fills the element's background.
- `background-image` – sets an image (e.g., `url('bg.jpg')`).
- `background-repeat` – controls tiling: `repeat`, `no-repeat`, `repeat-x`, `repeat-y`.
- `background-position` – positions the image (e.g., `center`, `top right`, `50% 50%`).
- `background-size` – `cover`, `contain`, or exact dimensions.
- `background-attachment` – `scroll` (default) or `fixed`.

Shorthand:
```css
body {
  background: #f0f0f0 url('bg.png') no-repeat center/cover;
}
```

quizData.question: `background-size: cover;` stretches the image to fit inside the element without cropping.
quizData.explanation: `cover` scales the image to cover the entire area, potentially cropping parts. `contain` fits the entire image without cropping.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Use Gradients

CSS gradients are background images. You can create linear, radial, and conic gradients without any image files:
```css
background: linear-gradient(to right, red, blue);
```
